# Iconography

Default icon family: Lucide-style outline, 16/20/24px, 1.75px stroke. Consistent optical alignment; provide accessible labels for icon-only controls. Decorative icons should be hidden from assistive technology. Avoid mixing emoji, filled glyphs, and unrelated icon families in one interface.

Illustrations: daylight, warm neutral, human, minimal; avoid neon gradients and generic glowing AI brains. Photography is optional, not a required brand element.
